itemBasicDescription: System name, brand icons and default locale formats.
itemAuthenticationDescription: Owner sign-in session lifetime and sign-in rate limits.
itemAccessControlDescription: Allow or deny access by IP address for all users.
itemWorkspaceDescription: Terminal tab limits and hibernation in the browser. Sign-in sessions are unaffected.
itemScheduledTasksDescription: Background job queue status and concurrency capacity.
itemNetworkDeploymentDescription: Reverse proxy, cookie, cross-origin and content security policies.
itemFileTransferDescription: Session transfers, background staging and the SSH/SFTP connection pool.
itemAIConfigDescription: Model service and API key used by the AI assistant.
itemNotificationConfigDescription: External channels that deliver task notifications; sending follows each account's notification preferences.
itemBackupDescription: Full instance backup, verification and restore. Use device sync for personal data across devices.
itemRetentionDescription: Retention periods and cleanup for task records and logs.
